summary: Talking head with illustrator Clara Reschke (woman in green striped shirt) in home office with bookshelves. She tells her personal story: childhood obsession with dogs led to illustrating personalized I Spy Dogs books for Wonderbly. Interspersed scenes of her dog Rocky getting excited, close-ups of colorful I Spy book pages with dog illustrations and hunt-the-dog gameplay, children with dog, family with dog, book cover details. Semi-polished video with on-screen text captions throughout.
